title: El cumpleaños
summary_en: It is Elena's birthday, but nobody seems to remember it. Her husband invites her to dinner.

pic.alt: Elena is sad at the flower shop on her birthday.

sentences.fr: Hoy es el cumpleaños de Elena.
sentences.en: Today is Elena's birthday.

sentences.fr: Elena tiene treinta años.
sentences.en: Elena is thirty years old.

sentences.fr: Trabaja en una tienda de flores.
sentences.en: She works in a flower shop.

sentences.fr: Por la mañana, nadie dice nada.
sentences.en: In the morning, nobody says anything.

sentences.fr: Su marido Javier no dice nada.
sentences.en: Her husband Javier says nothing.

sentences.fr: Sus amigos no llaman.
sentences.en: Her friends do not call.

sentences.fr: Elena está triste.
sentences.en: Elena is sad.

sentences.fr: Piensa: «Todos olvidan mi cumpleaños.»
sentences.en: She thinks: "Everyone forgets my birthday."

sentences.fr: Está muy triste.
sentences.en: She is very sad.

sentences.fr: Por la tarde, Javier llama a Elena.
sentences.en: In the afternoon, Javier calls Elena.

sentences.fr: «Vamos a cenar en casa de mi madre.»
sentences.en: "We are going to have dinner at my mother's house."

sentences.fr: «Estoy cansada», dice Elena.
sentences.en: "I am tired," says Elena.

sentences.fr: «Es solo una cena pequeña, por favor.»
sentences.en: "It is just a small dinner, please."

sentences.fr: Elena dice que sí.
sentences.en: Elena says yes.

sentences.fr: En el coche, Elena mira por la ventana.
sentences.en: In the car, Elena looks out of the window.

sentences.fr: Los dos llegan a la casa.
sentences.en: The two of them arrive at the house.

sentences.fr: La casa está oscura y muy tranquila.
sentences.en: The house is dark and very quiet.

pic.alt: Surprise! Friends and family cheer with balloons and confetti.

sentences.fr: Elena abre la puerta.
sentences.en: Elena opens the door.

sentences.fr: De repente, hay luz.
sentences.en: Suddenly, there is light.

sentences.fr: «¡Sorpresa!», gritan todos.
sentences.en: "Surprise!" everyone shouts.

sentences.fr: Los amigos están allí, y también la familia.
sentences.en: Her friends are there, and her family too.

sentences.fr: Hay globos, flores y una mesa grande.
sentences.en: There are balloons, flowers and a big table.

sentences.fr: Es una cena de cumpleaños.
sentences.en: It is a birthday dinner.

sentences.fr: Es una sorpresa para Elena.
sentences.en: It is a surprise for Elena.

sentences.fr: Hay música y mucha comida en la mesa.
sentences.en: There is music and lots of food on the table.

sentences.fr: Elena llora y ríe a la vez.
sentences.en: Elena cries and laughs at the same time.

sentences.fr: Javier está feliz también.
sentences.en: Javier is happy too.

pic.alt: A big cake with candles and the whole family around the table.

sentences.fr: Javier trae un pastel con velas.
sentences.en: Javier brings a cake with candles.

sentences.fr: El pastel es grande y blanco.
sentences.en: The cake is big and white.

sentences.fr: Hay treinta velas en el pastel.
sentences.en: There are thirty candles on the cake.

sentences.fr: Los amigos y la familia cantan «Cumpleaños feliz».
sentences.en: Friends and family sing "Happy Birthday".

sentences.fr: Elena mira las velas y sonríe.
sentences.en: Elena looks at the candles and smiles.

sentences.fr: Los niños comen pastel y ríen.
sentences.en: The children eat cake and laugh.

sentences.fr: Su abuela da un regalo a Elena.
sentences.en: Her grandmother gives Elena a present.

sentences.fr: Hay un regalo de Javier también.
sentences.en: There is a present from Javier too.

sentences.fr: El regalo es un libro con fotos de la familia.
sentences.en: The present is a book with photos of the family.

sentences.fr: «Es una sorpresa muy bonita», dice Elena.
sentences.en: "It is a very nice surprise," says Elena.

sentences.fr: Todos están en la mesa.
sentences.en: Everyone is at the table.

sentences.fr: «Gracias a todos, es una cena perfecta», dice Elena.
sentences.en: "Thank you all, it is a perfect dinner," says Elena.

sentences.fr: Ahora Elena no está triste, está feliz.
sentences.en: Now Elena is not sad, she is happy.

quiz.q_en: How is Elena in the morning?

o.fr: En casa de la madre de Javier

quiz.why: 'Vamos a cenar en casa de mi madre.'
